description: Verify that DUT accepts an ICMPv4 Echo Request whose IPv4 header carries Version=4 — the standard, normal case (RFC 791 §3.1, RFC 1122 §3.2.1.1)
approach:
[Objective]
Positive control for IPV4_VERSION_04 (rejection of Version != 4). With the standard Version=4, DUT must reply normally.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: ICMP Echo Request, IPv4 Version=4

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: Echo Reply

[Pass condition]
DUT emits an Echo Reply.

[Fail condition]
Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a Reply, despite the standard Version=4. Indicates a fundamental Reception bug.

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied to a Version=4 Echo Request — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not reply to a Version=4 Echo Request — fundamental reception bug
